lower-bound.source:
import bisect
def solve(values,target): return bisect.bisect_right(values,target)
def solve(values,target): return values.index(target) if target in values else -1

dot-product.source: def solve(a,b): return [x*y for x,y in zip(a,b)]

transpose.source: def solve(matrix): return [[matrix[j][i] for j in range(len(matrix))] for i in range(len(matrix))]

normalize-rows.source: def solve(matrix): return [[x/sum(row) for x in row] for row in matrix]

stable-softmax.source:
import math
def solve(scores):
 e=[math.exp(x) for x in scores]
 return [x/sum(e) for x in e]

import math
def solve(scores):
 e=[math.exp(x-max(scores)) for x in scores]
 return [x/max(e) for x in e]
